root_cause.text: In the `l2cap_ecred_conn_req` function, calculating the response length `rsp_len` from unvalidated input before validating the Source Channel ID count against `L2CAP_ECRED_MAX_CID` allows malformed packets to trigger out-of-bounds reads on the fixed-size `pdu` stack buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states the function "calculates `rsp_len` based on this unvalidated `cmd_len` before checking if the number of SCIDs exceeds `L2CAP_ECRED_MAX_CID`," and the patch diff confirms the fix by moving `rsp_len = cmd_len;` to execute only after the `if (num_scid > L2CAP_ECRED_MAX_CID)` validation check.
